provider: Infisical Universal Auth (controlled actual HTTP service)
steps: Open the real PWA and enter through the guest front door.
Create a durable PIN vault through the rendered Save/PIN controls.
Open Settings > Features and enable Connections.
Open Settings > Integrations > Infisical. Enter a name, the controlled API origin, project/environment/path and the fixture Universal Auth client credentials using the rendered fields.
Click Save secret backend and wait for the saved connection controls.
Arrange the owned HTTP fixture to hold the next Universal Auth login response. Click Test secret backend, and wait for the actual POST to reach the fixture.
Capture the pending viewport, then click the actual connection back link to leave the detail.
Observe native request identity/phases and server socket/response close before deliberately releasing the response. Preserve the baseline 300ms open observation or after 3000ms maximum close wait.
Release the fixture response, wait up to 1000ms for native completion/failure and a further 500ms for any authenticated GET. Capture the ordinary post-navigation Integrations viewport.
Reopen Infisical and click a fresh unheld Test secret backend. Require a newly issued fixture credential, actual authenticated GET and the rendered verified icon.
Close each context/fixture sequentially, then browser/app. Rehash all frozen inputs/artifact files and verify no owned live process or app/fixture listener remains.
automationNavigationQualification: Existing helper uses History API and popstate to enter Features/detail routes. PIN, feature toggle, configuration, Save, Test and departure backlink use actual rendered controls. No component/store-state injection.
observationsOnly: CDP/native HTTP/server lifecycle; no network interception, DOM injection or raw storage seeding.
safety: One attempt per phase, 120-second phase bound, desktop then touch sequentially; no automatic retry or timeout waiver.
